OFFICER DOWN.notes: Highest priority. Any law enforcement talkgroup valid. Officer in distress, shots fired at officer, code 3 backup.

SHOOTING.notes: Any talkgroup valid. GSW/gunshot wound/shots fired keywords sufficient.

STABBING.notes: Any talkgroup valid. Stab wound, edged weapon.

AIRCRAFT EMERGENCY.notes: ABIA tower, AFD aircraft response, mayday/pan-pan, gear issue, emergency landing.

MASS CASUALTY.notes: MCI declaration, multiple patients, triage tags, START triage.

STRUCTURE FIRE.notes: Working fire, smoke showing, fully involved. AFD/TCFD primary.

HAZMAT.notes: Hazmat team, decon, chemical spill, gas leak with evac.

HOSTAGE/BARRICADE.notes: SWAT activation, barricaded subject, hostage negotiator, perimeter.

CRASH/COLLISION.notes: MVC with injury or roadway closure. Routine fender-benders are not incidents.

FATAL CRASH.notes: Confirmed fatality on scene of MVC. ME en route or signal 27.

FIRE DISPATCH.notes: Box alarm, working assignment dispatched. AFD/TCFD.

TRANSIT INCIDENT.notes: Cap Metro bus/rail, MetroRail crossing, transit police response.

AIRPORT EMERGENCY.notes: ABIA ARFF, alert 1/2/3, gate hold, runway closure.

MULTI-AGENCY RESPONSE.notes: Two or more distinct agencies coordinating on the same incident. Requires corroboration.

APD SURGE.notes: Multiple APD units converging on a scene. Requires multiple calls to confirm surge pattern.

AIR ASSET ACTIVE.notes: STAR Flight, APD Air One, DPS aviation deployed to scene.

DPS CAPITOL ACTIVATION.notes: DPS Capitol detail surge, Capitol building lockdown or threat response.

DEATH INVESTIGATION.notes: ME-involved scenes only. CID talkgroups only. Utility jargon ('dead end' = pipe terminus) is a known false positive vector — never classify utility/public-works talkgroups as DEATH INVESTIGATION.
